e: Single word at 20 months c̅ otherwise normal motor/social milestones = isolated expressive language delay → refer for speech & hearing evaluation.
Listeria monocytogenes is a classic late-neonatal (beyond first week) meningitis pathogen.
Prolonged jaundice + umbilical hernia → congenital hypothyroidism.
PDA c̅ reversed (R→L)/Eisenmenger shunt sends deoxygenated blood to the lower body → differential cyanosis.
Regression at 6-18 months, ↓es head growth & stereotypic hand-wringing = Rett syndrome.
Café-au-lait macules are the earliest, most characteristic cutaneous sign of NF1.
Kawasaki disease → bilateral non-exudative/non-purulent conjunctival injection, NOT purulent discharge.
Asymptomatic neonatal hypoglycemia c̅ good feeding → continue breastfeeding & monitor rather than IV dextrose.
Transplacental anti-Ro/anti-La → neonatal lupus erythematosus c̅ congenital complete heart block.
Prolonged NICU stay → hospital-acquired (late-onset nosocomial) sepsis/meningitis → Staphylococcus aureus is the key organism.

Asymptomatic neonate c̅ mild hypoglycaemia (glucose ~25-45) → trial of feeds/breastfeeding first, then recheck.
IV dextrose is for symptomatic or very low (<25 mg/dL) glucose.
TTN: delayed lung-fluid clearance → hyperinflation c̅ prominent fissure; self-limiting.
Short limbs c̅ ↑ US:LS ratio (1.4) & normal milestones → achondroplasia (FGFR3).

Hirschsprung: failure of neural crest migration → aganglionic distal segment → obstruction.
Proximal normal segment is dilated.
Short stature c̅ obesity & frequent oral medicines → exogenous steroid-induced Cushing's.
Cholestasis c̅ pale stools & no HIDA excretion → biliary atresia; liver biopsy confirms.
Dengue c̅ warning sign (abdominal pain): IV isotonic crystalloid 5–7 ml/kg/hr.
FSGS: steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome c̅ segmental sclerosis & hyalinosis.
Severe paediatric DKA: NS bolus, insulin infusion, K⁺ 40 mmol/L when K⁺ normal; avoid bicarbonate.

Transfers objects hand to hand at 6 months.
Mature pincer – 12 months; tower of 2 blocks – 15 months.
PDA: continuous machinery murmur (left infraclavicular), recurrent pneumonia, acyanotic.
Ethosuximide – absence seizures only; not used in status epilepticus.
MMR is a live vaccine → contraindicated in SCID; inactivated vaccines are safe.

Turner: webbed neck, short 4th metacarpal, widely spaced hypoplastic nipples.
Prominent occiput is a feature of Edwards' syndrome.
Childhood ITP c̅ severe thrombocytopenia and ↑ megakaryocytes → IVIG (or steroids).
Neonatal CXR c̅ perihilar streaking, fluid in fissures and hyperinflation = transient tachypnoea of newborn; resolves in 48-72 h.
TOF = VSD + infundibular pulmonary stenosis + overriding aorta + RVH.
Rolling over, babbling 'dada/mama' and stranger anxiety are age-appropriate at 9 months.
Marasmus has no oedema; oedema in kwashiorkor is due to hypoalbuminaemia.
Aneuploidy = abnormal chromosome number; Bloom syndrome is an AR chromosomal-breakage disorder (BLM helicase).
Correct latch: lower lip everted, more areola visible above than below, chin touching breast, full cheeks.
Breast milk jaundice: free fatty acids/β-glucuronidase in milk inhibit conjugation → unconjugated hyperbilirubinaemia.
Niemann-Pick A: sphingomyelinase deficiency → hepatosplenomegaly, cherry-red spot, neuroregression (normal startle).
Hypopigmented ash-leaf macules (Wood's lamp) → tuberous sclerosis.
